full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows a bald, bearded man in a dark patterned jacket beside a contemporary concrete wall, looking calmly toward the bright left side of the frame. The background is divided into two distinct surfaces. Along the far left, a pale repeating triangular lattice catches daylight and forms a high-contrast diagonal strip. Behind most of the figure, a broad gray curved wall bears subtle rough marks and a few small warm points of reflected light. The man is placed in the right half, seen from the upper chest upward. His head turns slightly left and upward; the eyes narrow gently in the light, and a quiet half-smile softens the mouth. His close beard is visible along the chin and jaw. The dark high-collared jacket fills the lower right and center, with a discreet swirling woven pattern revealed where light crosses the fabric. A single large dark button sits beneath the collar. The shoulders make a firm sloping base for the rounded head, while the nearest edge of the concrete wall curves behind him. Daylight enters from the left, illuminating the left-facing planes of his forehead, cheek, and nose. The far side of the face remains darker, but retains enough detail to show skin texture and the beard. The architectural screen at the left is bright without becoming featureless; its repeated openings move out of focus toward the edge. The gray wall stays matte and gently textured, allowing the figure to separate by value more than by color. The palette remains restrained: charcoal clothing, warm brown skin, cool gray concrete, and pale near-white highlights. There is no readable text. The image is sharp around the face and collar and softer in the surrounding structural pattern. The overall composition balances a warm human presence against cool, repeated geometry, using side light and a close crop to give the quiet moment depth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片呈现一名秃头、蓄胡须的男子站在现代混凝土墙旁，身穿深色纹样外套，平静地望向画面明亮的左侧。背景分为两个明显表面。最左侧，浅色重复三角网格接住日光，形成高反差的斜向条带。人物大部分身后，一面宽阔的灰色弯曲墙壁带着细微粗糙痕迹及少数温暖的反光点。男子位于画面右半部，从胸部上方入镜。头略向左上转去；眼睛在亮光中轻轻眯起，嘴边安静的浅笑让表情柔和。下巴与颌线边缘可以看到短胡须。深色高领外套填满右下和中央，光照到布料时显出低调的旋纹织样。领口下有一枚大的深色纽扣。肩膀构成圆润头部下方稳固的斜坡基底，混凝土墙最近的边缘则在其身后弯曲。日光从左边进入，照亮额头、面颊和鼻子的朝左平面。脸的远侧较暗，却仍保留足够细节，显出肌肤质感与胡须。左侧建筑格栅明亮但并非全无细节；重复开口向边缘逐渐失焦。灰墙保持哑光与轻微肌理，让人物更多凭明度而非颜色从中分离。配色克制：炭黑衣服、暖褐皮肤、冷灰混凝土和近白高光。画面没有可读文字。脸和衣领附近清楚，周围结构图案较柔和。整体构图以温暖的人物存在平衡冷调重复几何，借侧光和贴近的裁切给安静一刻带来纵深。
style_prompt_en: The color photography uses restrained charcoal, warm brown, cool gray, and pale off-white tones. Soft natural side light gives rounded volumes gentle modeling while leaving broad matte surfaces evenly subdued. A close focal zone stands against large geometric fields: one carries a repeated high-contrast pattern, and another has a quiet curved plane with small irregular texture. The pattern recedes through shallow focus, so its many openings create rhythm without overtaking the central form. Dark woven detail becomes visible only where light grazes the surface, adding richness inside a nearly black area. Curves and sloping lines balance the repeated angular marks. The frame is cropped close but leaves enough negative space to let the two visual systems meet. The overall effect is composed and contemporary, with warmth emerging from subtle material differences and measured daylight.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色摄影使用克制的炭黑、暖褐、冷灰和浅灰白色调。柔和的自然侧光轻轻塑造圆润体积，使宽阔哑光表面保持均匀低调。贴近的焦点区域位于大块几何色域前：一块带有重复的高反差纹样，另一块是安静的曲面与细小不规则肌理。图案经浅景深逐渐后退，因此众多开口形成节奏，却不会压过中央形体。深色织纹仅在擦过表面的光下显现，为近黑区域增加丰富度。曲线和斜线平衡重复的棱角痕迹。画框贴近裁切，同时留下足够空处让两种视觉系统相遇。整体效果从容而现代，温度来自细微材料差异与有节制的日光。
theme_en: A man in a dark patterned jacket beside a geometric concrete wall
theme_zh: 几何混凝土墙旁身穿深色纹样外套的男子
name: David Adjaye
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
